title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 8. Calls, therefore, for an adequate reinforcement of heading 3 that allows the EU to support future enlargement, address rising development needs, the increasing number and duration of humanitarian crises and peace-building efforts, provide support to Ukraine and other partners, and uphold Union values, human rights and democracy worldwide while strengthening multilateralism; insists that humanitarian aid must continue to be ring-fenced, safeguarded and delivered through a coherent framework with an adequately resourced annual baseline, while upholding the principles of humanity, impartiality, neutrality and independence; recalls that humanitarian aid is principled and needs-based, and therefore requires predictable funding delivered through a coherent framework with an adequately resourced annual baseline, complemented by an adequate reserve for emergency actions; calls for a reinforcement of the envelope for overseas countries and territories, taking into consideration the recent threats to the territorial integrity of Greenland and the broader geopolitical context;
